column1: # Iliad - Part 2 — naskah 10 (M24010): garis pertahanan Pradaja jebol, The Elmo muncul
# begitu saja dari cahaya, Kalina mengambil alih komando dari Ullrid.
# Tetap Inggris: Pradaja, Paradajz, Littara, Doll Community, Sweeper, Balthilde, Warmaster,
# Dushevnaya, Mangi Security, Suomi, The Elmo, Groza, Ullrid, Mayling, Boojum, Porcelain,
# Fabric, Spectrum, Falconer, Interrupter, Kalina, Leva, Lenna, Makiatto, Springfield,
# Centaureissi, Dandelion, AR Team, Klukai, Nemesis, Lentine, Roberti, Lisa, Mokosh,
# Turul, T-Doll, Non-Military Forces Administration, Sangvis Ferri, Frame, Commander.
Ugh... the enemy's firepower is getting more and more intense.
column2: Ugh... daya tembak musuh makin lama makin ganas.

column1: At this rate, let alone the outskirts of Pradaja, even the main road will...
column2: Dengan laju begini, jangan bicara pinggiran Pradaja, jalan utamanya pun akan...

column1: (Groan)
column2: (Mengerang)

column1: (Although the area of the plantation here is far smaller than the scale of the thermal power plant, it is still the result of everyone's hard work over the past two months.)
column2: (Meski luas perkebunan di sini jauh lebih kecil dari skala pembangkit listrik termal, ini tetap hasil kerja keras semua orang selama dua bulan terakhir.)

column1: (Looking at the tomato juice splattering everywhere, and the planting base destroyed by the flames of war and human trampling.)
column2: (Menatap sari tomat yang berceceran ke mana-mana, dan basis tanam yang hancur oleh kobaran perang serta kaki-kaki manusia.)

column1: (After a long silence, Littara finally issues an order.)
column2: (Setelah lama terdiam, Littara akhirnya mengeluarkan perintah.)

column1: E-Evacuate this place.
column2: M-mundur dari tempat ini.

column1: Go to the m-main road.
column2: Pergi ke j-jalan utama.

column1: ...Tch, damn it!
column2: ...Cih, sialan!

column1: (As the Dolls withdrew from the planting base one after another, Littara, who was responsible for bringing up the rear, looked once again at the Paradajz experimental field that the Dolls had poured their hearts into building.)
column2: (Saat para Doll menarik diri dari basis tanam satu demi satu, Littara yang bertugas menutup barisan kembali menatap ladang percobaan Paradajz yang dibangun para Doll dengan sepenuh hati.)

column1: 呜！
column2: Ugh!

column1: 'Don't waste food—!' — Littara
column2: 'Jangan membuang-buang makanan—!' — Littara

column1: (After leaving her message, Littara also returned to the defense line on the main road.)
column2: (Setelah meninggalkan pesannya, Littara juga kembali ke garis pertahanan di jalan utama.)

column1: (However, as the enemy's armored forces advanced in coordination with self-propelled artillery, and the infantry turned into countless spearhead squads infiltrating inward bit by bit, the Doll Community's defenses gradually became unable to hold up, and they were forced to shrink their defense line.)
column2: (Namun saat pasukan lapis baja musuh maju berkoordinasi dengan artileri gerak sendiri, dan infanterinya berubah menjadi regu-regu ujung tombak tak terhitung yang menyusup ke dalam sedikit demi sedikit, pertahanan Doll Community berangsur tidak sanggup menahan, dan mereka terpaksa mengecilkan garis pertahanannya.)

column1: (Nearly half of the originally carefully arranged fire points didn't even have time to come into play. And those anti-vehicle obstacles deployed on the inevitable paths were also removed one by one by the enemy's experienced infantry-tank coordination tactics.)
column2: (Hampir separuh titik tembak yang semula disusun dengan cermat bahkan tidak sempat berfungsi. Dan penghalang antikendaraan yang dipasang di jalur yang pasti dilewati juga dibongkar satu per satu oleh taktik koordinasi infanteri-tank musuh yang berpengalaman.)

column1: We can't... retreat any further...
column2: Kita tidak bisa... mundur lagi...

column1: All members fighting on the main road, evacuate immediately! Detected that the enemy is about to use heavy howitzers, the covers in the ruins won't be able to withstand it!
column2: Semua anggota yang bertempur di jalan utama, segera mundur! Terdeteksi musuh akan memakai howitzer berat, penutup di puing tidak akan sanggup menahannya!

column1: The estimated trajectory impact point is the middle section of our defense line! Everyone evacuate immediately!
column2: Perkiraan titik jatuh lintasannya adalah bagian tengah garis pertahanan kita! Semuanya segera mundur!

column1: I repeat, abandon the defense line and evacuate to the flanks immediately!
column2: Kuulangi, tinggalkan garis pertahanan dan segera mundur ke sisi sayap!

column1: Everyone retreat quickly, I'll hold them off here!
column2: Semuanya cepat mundur, aku yang menahan mereka di sini!

column1: Ugh! Damn it, this frame is already...
column2: Ugh! Sialan, frame ini sudah...

column1: Leave me alone!
column2: Tinggalkan aku!

column1: Is this war...? Why would anyone like doing such things... | Commander, please give everyone strength, just like before...
column2: Jadi ini perang...? Kenapa ada yang suka melakukan hal seperti ini... | Commander, tolong beri semuanya kekuatan, seperti dulu...

column1: Cheer up! The Commander won't die over such a small thing! He even defeated Sangvis Ferri, what kind of formidable opponents are these guys?
column2: Semangat! Commander tidak akan mati karena hal kecil seperti ini! Dia bahkan mengalahkan Sangvis Ferri, mereka ini lawan sehebat apa sih?

column1: (Sweeper leaps between covers, buildings, and the invading forces like a nimble dragonfly, stirring up a spray of blood every time she jumps into the crowd.)
column2: (Sweeper melompat di antara penutup, bangunan, dan pasukan penyerbu seperti capung yang gesit, menyemburkan cipratan darah setiap kali dia melompat ke tengah kerumunan.)

column1: (The soldiers, pinned down at extremely close range, are unable to react immediately, and their offensive is hindered, which gives the other Dolls a brief moment to catch their breath and retreat.)
column2: (Para tentara yang tertekan di jarak sangat dekat tidak bisa bereaksi seketika, dan serangan mereka terhambat, yang memberi Doll lain sedikit waktu untuk menarik napas dan mundur.)

column1: (However, due to insufficient support fire, her movements quickly slow down from stray bullets hitting her Frame. Even though she can immediately deflect most of the bullets, the quality of the soldiers before her far exceeds any opponents she has encountered so far.)
column2: (Namun karena tembakan dukungan tidak memadai, gerakannya cepat melambat akibat proyektil liar yang mengenai Frame-nya. Meski dia bisa langsung menepis sebagian besar proyektil, kualitas tentara di depannya jauh melampaui lawan mana pun yang pernah dia jumpai.)

column1: (With extreme experience, they use a small number of people to desperately entangle her, and after retreating and opening fire, they inflict heavy damage on Sweeper.)
column2: (Dengan pengalaman yang luar biasa, mereka memakai sedikit orang untuk mengikatnya mati-matian, lalu setelah mundur dan melepas tembakan, mereka menimbulkan kerusakan berat pada Sweeper.)

column1: Ugh, hurry up and retreat—!
column2: Ugh, cepat mundur—!

column1: Don't get in the way, clear the battlefield! I'll take care of these guys.
column2: Jangan menghalangi, bersihkan medannya! Aku yang mengurus mereka.

column1: (Sweeper grabbed Balthilde and threw her frame to the rear, then immediately dropped to one knee, struggling to block the hail of bullets.)
column2: (Sweeper mencengkeram Balthilde dan melempar frame-nya ke belakang, lalu langsung berlutut satu kaki, susah payah menahan hujan proyektil.)

column1: Warmaster! I'll help you!
column2: Warmaster! Aku akan membantumu!

column1: (The bullets fired by Dushevnaya pierced the necks of two Mangi Security personnel operating heavy weapons.)
column2: (Proyektil yang ditembakkan Dushevnaya menembus leher dua personel Mangi Security yang mengoperasikan senjata berat.)

column1: (However, the enemy has already completed their encirclement and deployment of heavy weapons.)
column2: (Namun musuh sudah menyelesaikan pengepungan dan penempatan senjata beratnya.)

column1: (A thunderous boom resounds through the sky, accompanied by the sound of artillery shells firing from afar.)
column2: (Dentuman menggelegar bergaung di langit, disertai suara peluru artileri yang ditembakkan dari jauh.)

column1: (The Dolls evacuating from the defense line are hit by pursuing bullets and fall. Whether it's the path forward or the retreat route, everything is completely blocked.)
column2: (Para Doll yang mundur dari garis pertahanan terkena proyektil pengejar lalu tumbang. Baik jalan ke depan maupun jalur mundurnya, semuanya tertutup sepenuhnya.)

column1: (Even the sight of Dushevnaya being flipped over by artillery fire seems to become a despair-inducing slow-motion shot.)
column2: (Bahkan pemandangan Dushevnaya yang terjungkal oleh tembakan artileri seolah menjadi bidikan gerak lambat yang membuat putus asa.)

column1: What do we do...
column2: Bagaimana ini...

column1: (There is no sudden inspiration, nor any solid certainty. Under this absolute crushing disparity in strength, even a savior seems unwilling to descend.)
column2: (Tidak ada ilham yang tiba-tiba, tidak ada kepastian yang kokoh. Di bawah ketimpangan kekuatan yang menghancurkan secara mutlak itu, bahkan penyelamat pun seolah enggan turun.)

column1: (Littara felt a fear of failure that she hadn't experienced in a long time.)
column2: (Littara merasakan rasa takut akan kegagalan yang sudah lama tidak dia alami.)

column1: W-Wait—abnormal energy fluctuations detected... What is that!?
column2: T-tunggu—terdeteksi fluktuasi energi yang ganjil... Apa itu!?

column1: Littara!! At your one o'clock! About fifteen meters up, can you see it!?
column2: Littara!! Arah jam satu darimu! Sekitar lima belas meter di atas, kelihatan tidak!?

column1: (Littara looks in the direction Suomi indicated through the earpiece.)
column2: (Littara menoleh ke arah yang ditunjuk Suomi lewat penyuara telinganya.)

column1: (A speck of white light appeared in that place.)
column2: (Setitik cahaya putih muncul di tempat itu.)

column1: (Blinding and intense, completely unable to blend into the natural light.)
column2: (Menyilaukan dan dahsyat, sama sekali tidak bisa melebur ke cahaya alami.)

column1: That is...
column2: Itu...

column1: (Before Littara could form any thoughts, the white light instantly expanded, swallowing and silencing everything that approached it, including the large-caliber artillery shell that was about to land.)
column2: (Sebelum Littara sempat berpikir, cahaya putih itu seketika mengembang, menelan dan membungkam segala yang mendekatinya, termasuk peluru artileri berkaliber besar yang hampir jatuh.)

column1: (After the light faded, shadows followed. The massive existence that emerged from the white light and blocked everyone's view gradually revealed its true form—)
column2: (Setelah cahayanya memudar, bayangan menyusul. Eksistensi masif yang muncul dari cahaya putih itu dan menutup pandangan semua orang perlahan memperlihatkan bentuk aslinya—)

column1: I-It's the Elmo—how is that possible!?
column2: I-itu Elmo—mana mungkin!?

column1: 指挥官？！
column2: Commander?!

column1: (The sudden appearance of The Elmo out of thin air shocked the Dolls and also brought a strong impact to the enemy forces. Seemingly surprised by the appearance of this behemoth, the enemy's artillery fire also paused.)
column2: (Munculnya The Elmo secara mendadak dari kekosongan mengejutkan para Doll dan juga memberi guncangan kuat pada pasukan musuh. Sepertinya terkejut oleh kemunculan raksasa itu, tembakan artileri musuh pun berhenti sesaat.)

column1: (And in just this brief opening, Groza and the other Dolls on The Elmo leaped down one after another, raising their weapons and launching a counterattack against the surrounding Mangi Security forces.)
column2: (Dan hanya dalam celah singkat itu, Groza serta para Doll lain di The Elmo melompat turun satu demi satu, mengangkat senjata mereka dan melancarkan serangan balik ke pasukan Mangi Security di sekitarnya.)

column1: This... this... Ullrid, did you see that?
column2: Ini... ini... Ullrid, kau lihat itu?

column1: How could The Elmo... appear out of thin air?
column2: Bagaimana The Elmo bisa... muncul dari kekosongan?

column1: (Ullrid still couldn't believe the authenticity of the images on the monitor.)
column2: (Ullrid masih tidak bisa percaya keaslian citra di monitornya.)

column1: (Although it temporarily slowed down the enemy's offensive, this supernatural phenomenon still caused her processing power to overload a bit.)
column2: (Meski itu sementara memperlambat serangan musuh, fenomena supernatural itu tetap membuat daya prosesnya sedikit kelebihan beban.)

column1: What exactly happened on the Commander's side... No, The Elmo's condition is terrible.
column2: Sebenarnya apa yang terjadi di pihak Commander... Bukan, kondisi The Elmo buruk sekali.

column1: Suomi! Try to establish communications with The Elmo immediately!
column2: Suomi! Coba bangun komunikasi dengan The Elmo sekarang!

column1: Porcelain, Fabric, and Spectrum, provide artillery cover for The Elmo's retreat immediately!
column2: Porcelain, Fabric, dan Spectrum, segera beri perlindungan artileri untuk mundurnya The Elmo!

column1: Falconer and Interrupter squads, use smokescreens and electronic jamming to protect The Elmo!
column2: Regu Falconer dan Interrupter, pakai tabir asap dan gangguan elektronik untuk melindungi The Elmo!

column1: Ah, o-okay!
column2: Ah, b-baik!

column1: (The communication interface expands on the screen. After a long dial tone, the connection is successfully established.)
column2: (Antarmuka komunikasinya membentang di layar. Setelah nada sambung yang panjang, sambungannya berhasil terbentuk.)

column1: (A somewhat haggard image of Mayling appears on the screen.)
column2: (Citra Mayling yang tampak agak kuyu muncul di layar.)

column1: It's... Miss Mayling!
column2: Itu... Miss Mayling!

column1: Ugh... Ull... Miss Ullrid... ugh... my head...
column2: Ugh... Ull... Miss Ullrid... ugh... kepalaku...

column1: This is... Pradaja?!
column2: Ini... Pradaja?!

column1: Wh-what is going on?! How did we... could it be that time...
column2: A-ada apa ini?! Bagaimana kami bisa... jangan-jangan waktu itu...

column1: Yes, you are on the main road leading out of Pradaja.
column2: Iya, kalian ada di jalan utama yang keluar dari Pradaja.

column1: What's the situation with The Elmo? I've already sent people to reinforce you! Is the Commander there?
column2: Bagaimana kondisi The Elmo? Aku sudah mengirim orang untuk membantu kalian! Apa Commander di situ?

column1: The Commander, the Commander isn't here...
column2: Commander, Commander tidak ada di sini...

column1: W-we were fighting that dragon-type Boojum at the time, and then it emitted a bright light... After that, uh...
column2: K-kami waktu itu sedang bertempur dengan Boojum bertipe naga itu, lalu muncul cahaya yang terang... Setelah itu, eh...

column1: The Commander... told us not to worry... but...
column2: Commander... menyuruh kami tidak khawatir... tapi...

column1: ...And then... we...
column2: ...Lalu... kami...

column1: (It didn't seem like a scenario that could be understood in a short amount of time.)
column2: (Sepertinya ini bukan situasi yang bisa dipahami dalam waktu singkat.)

column1: (Or rather, Ullrid realized that Mayling didn't seem able to explain the current situation in detail either.)
column2: (Atau lebih tepatnya, Ullrid menyadari Mayling sepertinya juga tidak bisa menjelaskan situasi sekarang secara rinci.)

column1: ...Let's put that aside for now.
column2: ...Kita kesampingkan itu dulu.

column1: Can the Elmo still start? You need to leave the main road as soon as possible.
column2: Elmo masih bisa menyala? Kalian harus meninggalkan jalan utama secepat mungkin.

column1: Balthilde and the others will support you as soon as possible!
column2: Balthilde dan yang lain akan membantu kalian secepatnya!

column1: Alright...
column2: Baik...

column1: (Ullrid sat back in the command seat, her hand resting on her chest.)
column2: (Ullrid kembali duduk di kursi komandonya, tangannya bertumpu di dadanya.)

column1: (The moment she saw the Elmo, aside from the shock brought by the supernatural phenomenon, Ullrid also felt an indescribable sense of relief.)
column2: (Saat melihat Elmo, selain guncangan akibat fenomena supernatural itu, Ullrid juga merasakan kelegaan yang tak bisa dijelaskan.)

column1: (But the Commander didn't come, the Commander isn't here. The battle situation in Paradajz is still extremely unfavorable for us.)
column2: (Tapi Commander tidak datang, Commander tidak ada di sini. Situasi pertempuran di Paradajz tetap sangat tidak menguntungkan bagi kami.)

column1: (Moreover, the Elmo's condition is terrible, and from the surveillance screens, it can be seen that the Dolls who came down from the Elmo are also severely damaged.)
column2: (Lebih dari itu, kondisi Elmo buruk sekali, dan dari layar pengawasan terlihat para Doll yang turun dari Elmo juga rusak berat.)

column1: (The excessive information and shock made it hard for her to recover, and she didn't even hear the sound of the command room door opening.)
column2: (Informasi dan guncangan yang berlebihan membuatnya sulit pulih, sampai dia tidak mendengar bunyi pintu ruang komando terbuka.)

column1: Our reinforcements have arrived!
column2: Bala bantuan kita sudah datang!

column1: (A push snapped her out of her daze.)
column2: (Sebuah dorongan menyadarkannya dari lamunan.)

column1: (She looked up and saw Suomi, and behind her—)
column2: (Dia mengangkat kepala dan melihat Suomi, dan di belakangnya—)

column1: 你……你是……
column2: Kau... kau ini...

column1: Sister! This is Miss Kalina! She is an important partner of the Commander!
column2: Kak! Ini Miss Kalina! Dia rekan penting Commander!

column1: And... this is Miss Leva, and Miss Lenna!
column2: Dan... ini Miss Leva, dan Miss Lenna!

column1: Yoohoo~ Reinforcements are here! Although it's just the three of us for now.
column2: Yuhu~ Bala bantuan datang! Meski untuk sekarang cuma kami bertiga.

column1: ...For now?
column2: ...Untuk sekarang?

column1: That's right, there's also some support that, while a bit restless, is powerful and strong.
column2: Benar, masih ada bantuan lain yang meski agak tidak bisa diam, tapi kuat dan tangguh.

column1: There are still reinforcements now? Who exactly are they? How many will there be?
column2: Masih ada bala bantuan lagi? Siapa mereka sebenarnya? Berapa jumlahnya?

column1: Hmm... their identities are a bit sensitive.
column2: Hmm... identitas mereka agak sensitif.

column1: Anyway, they are reliable... companions?
column2: Pokoknya mereka rekan... yang bisa diandalkan?

column1: Reliable companions... huh?
column2: Rekan yang bisa diandalkan... ya?

column1: (Ullrid had heard the names of these three more than once in documents and rumors. Although they had never met, she had more or less had indirect contact with them after the Commander's arrival.)
column2: (Ullrid sudah lebih dari sekali mendengar nama ketiganya di dokumen dan gosip. Meski belum pernah bertemu, dia sedikit banyak sudah punya kontak tidak langsung dengan mereka setelah Commander datang.)

column1: ...I understand.
column2: ...Aku paham.

column1: Alright Leva, Lenna, you go do what you need to do first.
column2: Baik Leva, Lenna, kalian kerjakan dulu apa yang perlu kalian kerjakan.

column1: Leave the negotiation issues to me.
column2: Serahkan urusan negosiasinya padaku.

column1: 了解~
column2: Dimengerti~

column1: Let me know after the handover is complete.
column2: Beri tahu aku setelah serah terimanya selesai.

column1: Alright.
column2: Baik.

column1: (Faced with the urgent situation, even Leva has less leeway, and without any delay, she leaves the command room together with Lenna.)
column2: (Menghadapi situasi yang mendesak, Leva pun punya lebih sedikit kelonggaran, dan tanpa menunda, dia meninggalkan ruang komando bersama Lenna.)

column1: First of all, thank you for the secret passage you provided, Ullrid.
column2: Pertama-tama, terima kasih untuk jalur rahasia yang kau sediakan, Ullrid.

column1: Thanks to you, we didn't encounter any Mangi Security forces along the way. Otherwise, even if we borrowed the enemy's identification system, we wouldn't have been able to deliver the supplies in time.
column2: Berkat kau, kami tidak berjumpa satu pun pasukan Mangi Security di jalan. Kalau tidak, meski kami meminjam sistem identifikasi musuh, kami tidak akan bisa mengantar pasokannya tepat waktu.

column1: Suomi has already told us about the battle situation here and the matter with The Elmo.
column2: Suomi sudah menceritakan situasi pertempuran di sini dan soal The Elmo.

column1: (Suomi, standing behind Kalina, shoots a reassuring glance.)
column2: (Suomi yang berdiri di belakang Kalina melempar tatapan menenangkan.)

column1: Thank you for your support, Miss Kalina.
column2: Terima kasih atas bantuanmu, Miss Kalina.

column1: By the way, Miss Kalina, do you know what's going on with The Elmo, and... the Commander...
column2: Ngomong-ngomong, Miss Kalina, kau tahu apa yang terjadi dengan The Elmo, dan... Commander...

column1: ...Sorry, I don't understand what's going on either. Judging from Suomi's account... this is absolutely not something that can be achieved with current manpower or technological means.
column2: ...Maaf, aku juga tidak paham apa yang terjadi. Dari cerita Suomi... ini sama sekali bukan hal yang bisa dicapai dengan tenaga manusia atau teknologi yang ada sekarang.

column1: If I had to describe it, it would be some kind of 'miracle'.
column2: Kalau harus digambarkan, ini semacam 'keajaiban'.

column1: A miracle...?
column2: Keajaiban...?

column1: I don't know the details... but I believe he will be safe and sound.
column2: Aku tidak tahu detailnya... tapi aku percaya dia akan selamat.

column1: (Kalina bit her lip.)
column2: (Kalina menggigit bibirnya.)

column1: (She was also worried about the Commander, but perhaps the Commander had now gone to a realm she couldn't step into at all.)
column2: (Dia juga mengkhawatirkan Commander, tapi mungkin Commander sekarang sudah pergi ke ranah yang sama sekali tidak bisa dia jejaki.)

column1: Miss Ullrid, I have a request.
column2: Miss Ullrid, aku punya satu permintaan.

column1: Could I ask you to hand over the command of Pradaja to me?
column2: Bisakah kuminta kau menyerahkan komando Pradaja padaku?

column1: In the current battle situation, Pradaja has no safe cards left to play.
column2: Dalam situasi pertempuran sekarang, Pradaja tidak punya kartu aman yang bisa dimainkan lagi.

column1: The combat strength of every T-Doll is an indispensable existence for protecting this place, and as one of the highest combat strengths in the Doll Community, you should go to the position most suitable for you.
column2: Kekuatan tempur setiap T-Doll adalah eksistensi yang tidak bisa dilepas untuk melindungi tempat ini, dan sebagai salah satu kekuatan tempur tertinggi di Doll Community, kau harus pergi ke posisi yang paling sesuai untukmu.

column1: (Ullrid felt some hesitation.)
column2: (Ullrid merasakan sedikit keraguan.)

column1: (It wasn't out of an attachment to command—on the contrary, what she was thinking was exactly the same as what Kalina had said.)
column2: (Itu bukan karena keterikatan pada kursi komando—sebaliknya, yang dia pikirkan sama persis dengan yang dikatakan Kalina.)

column1: (Whenever she saw the Dolls being attacked on the monitors, she wished she could be there in person to protect her comrades.)
column2: (Setiap kali melihat para Doll diserang di monitor, dia ingin bisa ada di sana secara langsung untuk melindungi rekan-rekannya.)
(Tapi...)

column1: ...Won't this be too much of a burden on you?
column2: ...Apa ini tidak terlalu membebanimu?

column1: Also, I heard that you...
column2: Selain itu, kudengar kau...

column1: (Ullrid didn't finish her sentence, but Kalina knew what she was referring to.)
column2: (Ullrid tidak menyelesaikan kalimatnya, tapi Kalina tahu apa yang dia maksud.)

column1: Don't worry, ten years ago, I also followed the Commander through many battles, so I picked up a trick or two.
column2: Jangan khawatir, sepuluh tahun lalu aku juga mengikuti Commander melewati banyak pertempuran, jadi aku memungut satu-dua trik.

column1: Besides, I haven't wasted my time over the past ten years. It would be too ridiculous if a counselor of the Non-Military Forces Administration didn't understand military affairs.
column2: Lagi pula aku tidak membuang waktu sepuluh tahun ini. Terlalu lucu kalau seorang penasihat Non-Military Forces Administration tidak paham urusan militer.

column1: As for me... there is no safer place for me than here. As long as the radiation concentration doesn't continue to rise, I won't have any problems.
column2: Soal aku... tidak ada tempat yang lebih aman bagiku daripada di sini. Selama konsentrasi radiasinya tidak terus naik, aku tidak akan bermasalah.

column1: Leva and Lenna have already gone to reinforce The Elmo. Counting the combat strength of Groza and the other members of The Elmo... we are not without hope.
column2: Leva dan Lenna sudah pergi memperkuat The Elmo. Dihitung dengan kekuatan tempur Groza dan anggota The Elmo lainnya... kita bukan tanpa harapan.

column1: (Kalina looks at the monitor in the command room, locking onto the enemy's artillery positions.)
column2: (Kalina menatap monitor di ruang komando, mengunci posisi artileri musuh.)

column1: That's right, we have a chance.
column2: Benar, kita punya peluang.

column1: (Kalina reaches her hand out to Ullrid.)
column2: (Kalina mengulurkan tangannya kepada Ullrid.)

column1: ...If we stand united, we can definitely turn this situation around.
column2: ...Kalau kita bersatu, kita pasti bisa membalikkan situasi ini.

column1: Let's fight a beautiful battle together!
column2: Mari bertempur dengan indah bersama-sama!

column1: (Ullrid looks at Kalina's hand and grasps it without hesitation.)
column2: (Ullrid menatap tangan Kalina dan menggenggamnya tanpa ragu.)

column1: I understand. I'll leave the commanding of everyone to you.
column2: Aku paham. Kuserahkan komando semuanya padamu.

column1: Suomi, please assist Miss Kalina.
column2: Suomi, tolong bantu Miss Kalina.

column1: Yeah! Leave it to me.
column2: Siap! Serahkan padaku.

column1: What's going on, Groza! The Commander, why isn't the Commander here? Where did you say he and the AR Team went!?
column2: Ada apa ini, Groza! Commander, kenapa Commander tidak ada? Kau bilang dia dan AR Team pergi ke mana!?

column1: (While searching for a suitable sniping position in Paradajz, Makiatto vented her dissatisfaction and confusion over the comms.)
column2: (Sambil mencari posisi tembak jitu yang cocok di Paradajz, Makiatto meluapkan ketidakpuasan dan kebingungannya lewat komunikasi.)

column1: I... I can't be sure. Dandelion, no, that wasn't Dandelion, she was...
column2: Aku... aku tidak bisa memastikan. Dandelion, bukan, itu bukan Dandelion, dia...

column1: Calm down, Makiatto. For now, we need to follow orders and hold Paradajz.
column2: Tenang, Makiatto. Untuk sekarang kita harus menjalankan perintah dan mempertahankan Paradajz.

column1: If this place falls too, the Doll Community will be completely exposed!
column2: Kalau tempat ini juga jatuh, Doll Community akan terbongkar sepenuhnya!

column1: But the Commander might be in danger! First the AR Team, then Dandelion, why can't I find a single one of them on the comms channel.
column2: Tapi Commander mungkin dalam bahaya! Pertama AR Team, lalu Dandelion, kenapa aku tidak bisa menemukan satu pun dari mereka di saluran komunikasi.

column1: Springfield, no... I think we need to go...
column2: Springfield, tidak... kurasa kita harus pergi...

column1: (Facing the agitated Makiatto, before Springfield could speak, a steady, slender hand gently pressed onto her shoulder.)
column2: (Menghadapi Makiatto yang gusar, sebelum Springfield bicara, sebuah tangan lentik yang mantap menekan lembut bahunya.)

column1: When the Commander is away, we just need to carry out the tasks he assigned, and keep doing so until he returns... that's all.
column2: Saat Commander tidak ada, kita hanya perlu menjalankan tugas yang dia berikan, dan terus begitu sampai dia kembali... itu saja.

column1: Centaureissi, I, I...!
column2: Centaureissi, a-aku...!

column1: I... believe in the Commander, Makiatto. You do too, and you believe in the Commander more than anyone else, don't you?
column2: Aku... percaya pada Commander, Makiatto. Kau juga, dan kau lebih percaya pada Commander dari siapa pun, kan?
...Ugh!

column1: I... I'm sorry, I got too excited...
column2: A-aku minta maaf, aku terlalu terbawa emosi...

column1: That idiot Commander, making people worry so much. I'll definitely settle the score with him later!
column2: Commander bodoh itu, membuat orang khawatir sebesar ini. Nanti pasti akan kuperhitungkan dengannya!

column1: Groza, you need to pull yourself together too.
column2: Groza, kau juga harus menguatkan diri.

column1: All we can do is trust the Commander, right?
column2: Yang bisa kita lakukan hanya memercayai Commander, kan?

column1: Yep.
column2: Ya.

column1: Mayling, try to reboot Klukai and the others as much as possible, and confirm Nemesis's situation.
column2: Mayling, coba reboot Klukai dan yang lain sebanyak mungkin, dan pastikan kondisi Nemesis.

column1: All Dolls on The Elmo who can still move, move out with me!
column2: Semua Doll di The Elmo yang masih bisa bergerak, ikut aku!

column1: Captain Groza, I, I understand...!
column2: Captain Groza, a-aku mengerti...!

column1: I will definitely defend The Elmo with everyone while the Commander is away!
column2: Aku pasti akan mempertahankan The Elmo bersama semuanya selama Commander tidak ada!

column1: ...Where on earth did that The Elmo pop out from?
column2: ...Sebenarnya The Elmo itu muncul dari mana?

column1: What is the recon squad doing?! Did they not spot the enemy's appearance in advance?!
column2: Regu pengintai sedang apa?! Mereka tidak melihat kemunculan musuh lebih dulu?!

column1: (The imminent victory is abruptly interrupted, and the vanguard troops suffer an enemy attack without receiving any early warning.)
column2: (Kemenangan yang sudah di depan mata terputus mendadak, dan pasukan pendahulu menerima serangan musuh tanpa peringatan dini apa pun.)

column1: (Lentine's anger was palpable. She immediately demanded the team confirm the enemy's route of advance and grasp their movements.)
column2: (Kemarahan Lentine terasa jelas. Dia langsung menuntut regunya memastikan rute maju musuh dan memahami gerakan mereka.)

column1: It's still unclear... I confirmed with all the witnesses at the time, and we can rule out possibilities like optical camouflage.
column2: Masih belum jelas... Saya sudah memastikan dengan semua saksi di lokasi, dan kemungkinan seperti kamuflase optik bisa dikesampingkan.

column1: It just... appeared there out of thin air.
column2: Benda itu cuma... muncul di sana dari kekosongan.

column1: It seems the other side didn't expect this to happen either... Both of us suffered some damage as a result.
column2: Sepertinya pihak sana juga tidak menduga ini terjadi... Kedua pihak sama-sama menderita kerusakan karenanya.

column1: As for that supply squad... we lost contact with several peripheral patrol squads.
column2: Soal regu pasokan itu... kami kehilangan kontak dengan beberapa regu patroli tepi.

column1: It seems they approached us using the patrol squads' identification signals after taking them out.
column2: Sepertinya mereka mendekat memakai sinyal identifikasi regu patroli itu setelah menghabisinya.

column1: ...What are the casualties of the armored forces?
column2: ...Berapa korban pasukan lapis baja?

column1: The combat power of the Dolls that came down from The Elmo far exceeds those modified civilian Dolls from before... The 1st Battalion's damage rate exceeded 50%, and they have retreated.
column2: Kekuatan tempur Doll yang turun dari The Elmo jauh melampaui Doll sipil hasil modifikasi sebelumnya... Tingkat kerusakan Batalion 1 melewati 50%, dan mereka sudah mundur.

column1: The assault squad is pinned down by the Doll forces from The Elmo and cannot advance further.
column2: Regu serbu tertekan oleh pasukan Doll dari The Elmo dan tidak bisa maju lagi.

column1: We need to investigate this matter as soon as possible.
column2: Kita harus menyelidiki urusan ini secepat mungkin.

column1: ...Roberti, bring up Armored Mixed Teams 3 and 4.
column2: ...Roberti, panggil Armored Mixed Team 3 dan 4.

column1: Also, notify Lisa to transfer the people left in Mokosh and Turul over here.
column2: Selain itu, beri tahu Lisa untuk memindahkan orang-orang yang tersisa di Mokosh dan Turul ke sini.

column1: Armored mixed formations Team 2 and Team 3 will target The Elmo. No matter what is on that vehicle, leave no survivors!
column2: Formasi campuran lapis baja Team 2 dan Team 3 menyasar The Elmo. Apa pun yang ada di kendaraan itu, jangan tinggalkan satu pun yang hidup!

column1: From now on, Armored Mixed Team 4 will clear the way, and artillery will launch saturation strikes against all enemy active forces.
column2: Mulai sekarang, Armored Mixed Team 4 membuka jalan, dan artileri melancarkan serangan saturasi ke seluruh kekuatan aktif musuh.

column1: We must take this town!
column2: Kita harus merebut kota ini!

column1: Lentine, our rear...
column2: Lentine, bagian belakang kita...

column1: Execute the order.
column2: Jalankan perintahnya.

column1: Yes...
column2: Baik...

column1: ...Tch... Whether you're there or not, it doesn't change our policy or the outcome.
column2: ...Cih... Kau ada di sana atau tidak, itu tidak mengubah kebijakan kami maupun hasilnya.

column1: A mere small town, we must take it within 24 hours!
column2: Kota kecil begitu saja, harus kita rebut dalam 24 jam!

column1: (This was a fatal mistake.)
column2: (Itu kesalahan yang fatal.)

column1: (The moment she realized that Mangi Security's heavy infantry had quietly infiltrated the flank under the cover of artillery fire, Littara had already rushed to reinforce with Balthilde at top speed.)
column2: (Begitu menyadari infanteri berat Mangi Security menyusup diam-diam ke sisi sayap di balik perlindungan tembakan artileri, Littara sudah bergegas memperkuat posisi bersama Balthilde dengan kecepatan penuh.)

column1: (But the enemy's infiltration speed far exceeded everyone's preparations. This plantation located on the left flank of Paradajz had now been completely overrun by Mangi Security.)
column2: (Tapi kecepatan penyusupan musuh jauh melampaui persiapan semua orang. Perkebunan yang terletak di sayap kiri Paradajz itu sekarang sudah sepenuhnya dikuasai Mangi Security.)

column1: (In the recent offensive and defensive battle, she had mobilized all her processing power, yet she still couldn't properly command all the combat units of the Doll Community.)
column2: (Dalam pertempuran serang-tahan belakangan ini, dia sudah mengerahkan seluruh daya prosesnya, tapi tetap tidak bisa mengomando semua unit tempur Doll Community dengan baik.)

column1: (The most direct consequence of this was that she failed to predict that the enemy, after suffering losses to their armored units, would immediately switch to infiltration tactics like a venomous snake. Her own gaze was firmly drawn by the enemy's frontal armored forces, failing to take care of the town's vulnerable flanks.)
column2: (Akibat paling langsungnya adalah dia gagal memprediksi bahwa musuh, setelah kehilangan unit lapis baja, akan langsung beralih ke taktik penyusupan seperti ular berbisa. Pandangannya sendiri tertambat kuat pada pasukan lapis baja musuh di depan, sampai lalai menjaga sayap kota yang rapuh.)

column1: (And now, she didn't know what to do. Just how much infantry did the enemy still have uncommitted? Just how many heavy armored forces were on standby? Could the 'attrition tactics' she had executed earlier still continue? How she wished the Commander could stand by her side right now and tell her what she should do.)
column2: (Dan sekarang dia tidak tahu harus bagaimana. Sebenarnya berapa banyak infanteri musuh yang belum diterjunkan? Berapa banyak pasukan lapis baja berat yang bersiaga? Apa 'taktik gerus' yang dia jalankan tadi masih bisa dilanjutkan? Betapa dia ingin Commander bisa berdiri di sisinya sekarang dan memberitahunya apa yang harus dia lakukan.)

column1: (But, even if they are the Commander's past companions and people Suomi absolutely trusts, can she herself trust them without reservation? Can they be accepted by everyone in the Doll Community fighting on the frontline? Can the 'reinforcements' with sensitive identities they speak of truly be trusted in this desperate situation?)
column2: (Tapi meski mereka rekan lama Commander dan orang-orang yang sepenuhnya dipercaya Suomi, apa dia sendiri bisa memercayai mereka tanpa syarat? Apa mereka bisa diterima semua orang di Doll Community yang bertempur di garis depan? Apa 'bala bantuan' dengan identitas sensitif yang mereka sebut itu benar-benar bisa dipercaya dalam situasi putus asa ini?)

column1: (Ullrid shakes her head vigorously. She knows she is weakly considering unnecessary and self-consuming problems again.)
column2: (Ullrid menggeleng keras. Dia tahu dia kembali dengan lemah memikirkan masalah yang tidak perlu dan menggerogoti dirinya sendiri.)

column1: (A sudden transfer of command requires the successor to immediately grasp the predecessor's tactical intentions and understand the overall situation. For Dolls with high processing power, this might just be a simple matter of reading tactical data, but for a human, it requires a terrifying talent for information extraction and stress tolerance.)
column2: (Peralihan komando yang mendadak menuntut penerusnya langsung memahami niat taktis pendahulunya dan menguasai gambaran keseluruhan. Untuk Doll dengan daya proses tinggi, itu mungkin cuma soal membaca data taktis, tapi untuk manusia, itu menuntut bakat menyerap informasi dan ketahanan tekanan yang mengerikan.)

column1: (As Kalina spoke, she skillfully reached out and opened the holographic tactical planning map.)
column2: (Sembari bicara, Kalina dengan cekatan mengulurkan tangan dan membuka peta perencanaan taktis holografis.)

column1: (Looking at the familiar defense line markers and the familiar tactical style—winning with fewer numbers, fighting the strong with the weak, a tactical mindset that targeted the enemy's pain points with every move... Yes, this was the handiwork of the person she was most familiar with.)
column2: (Menatap penanda garis pertahanan yang dia kenal dan gaya taktis yang dia kenal—menang dengan jumlah lebih sedikit, melawan yang kuat dengan yang lemah, pola pikir taktis yang setiap langkahnya menyasar titik sakit musuh... Ya, ini karya orang yang paling dia kenal.)

column1: (Looking at the traces the Commander left on this sandbox, Kalina couldn't help but reveal a warm smile.)
column2: (Menatap jejak yang ditinggalkan Commander di meja pasir itu, Kalina tidak bisa menahan senyum hangatnya.)

column1: (Right now, she might not be able to formulate such exquisite tactics out of thin air. But simply using the tactical framework the Commander had already laid out to continue skirmishing and wearing down the enemy was not impossible for her.)
column2: (Sekarang dia mungkin tidak bisa menyusun taktik seindah itu dari nol. Tapi hanya memakai kerangka taktis yang sudah dibentangkan Commander untuk terus menggerogoti dan menguras musuh bukan hal mustahil untuknya.)

column1: (As for the other problem with her body... no matter what, she would absolutely not back down again.)
column2: (Soal masalah lain di tubuhnya... apa pun yang terjadi, dia sama sekali tidak akan mundur lagi.)

column1: (If Littara and the others hadn't used agricultural machinery to set up defenses in advance, the entirety of Pradaja might have already been completely infiltrated by the enemy's special forces.)
column2: (Kalau Littara dan yang lain tidak memakai mesin pertanian untuk memasang pertahanan lebih dulu, seluruh Pradaja mungkin sudah sepenuhnya disusupi pasukan khusus musuh.)
